processes:task-eo-design-intake-qvjmg4.plain_language_name: Receive the Layouts, Equipment, and Demand Model
processes:task-eo-design-intake-qvjmg4.plain_language_description: Capacity modelling opens when the layout designs, equipment specifications, and demand model are handed over together as the inputs the capacity envelopes will be modelled from. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the modelling from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-eo-design-intake-qvjmg4.business_purpose: It exists so capacity is modelled from the designed arrangements against the demand they must serve.
processes:task-eo-design-intake-qvjmg4.practical_context: It opens when the inputs are presented for the modelling, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the layouts, equipment specification, and demand model as the modelling baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-eo-design-transform-zknr3.plain_language_name: Work Out What the Blueprint Can Hold
processes:task-eo-design-transform-zknr3.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian does the modelling itself: the throughput bounds and scaling limits of the designed facilities and assets are modelled from the layouts, equipment, and demand, and the capacity envelope model is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-design-transform-zknr3.business_purpose: It exists because a facility without modelled capacity surprises everyone the first busy season - the model is where the limits are found on paper first.
processes:task-eo-design-transform-zknr3.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be modelled from, and it ends with the capacity envelope model produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the operations function models the throughput bounds and scaling limits of each designed facility, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-design-verify-yd7x8b.plain_language_name: Check the Inputs Before Modelling the Capacity
processes:task-eo-design-verify-yd7x8b.plain_language_description: Before any capacity is modelled, the verification custodian checks the inputs against what modelling requires - that the layouts and equipment are the designed sets and the demand model is the current one. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the modelling begins.
processes:task-eo-design-verify-yd7x8b.business_purpose: It exists so capacity is never modelled from superseded layouts or a stale demand picture.
processes:task-eo-design-verify-yd7x8b.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the demand model a season behind and logs the defect before any capacity is modelled.

processes:task-eo-design-intake-nmmguw.plain_language_description: Specification opens when the layout designs and the asset lifecycle envelopes are handed over together as the frame each piece of equipment must be specified within. The intake custodian accepts both, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the specification from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-eo-design-intake-nmmguw.business_purpose: It exists so equipment is specified into designed layouts under the lifecycle postures, not bought ad hoc.
processes:task-eo-design-intake-nmmguw.practical_context: It opens when the layouts and envelopes are presented for specification, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps cleared to proceed.

processes:task-eo-design-transform-3mah3.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian does the specification itself: the equipment populating each designed layout is specified to the standard the lifecycle envelopes demand, and the equipment specification is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-design-transform-3mah3.business_purpose: It exists because layouts with unspecified equipment are empty rooms - the specification is what names every piece that fills them.
processes:task-eo-design-transform-3mah3.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be specified from, and it ends with the equipment specification produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the operations function names every piece of equipment each layout needs, to the standard the envelopes demand, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-design-verify-xsnx4h.plain_language_name: Check the Layouts and Envelopes Before Specifying Equipment
processes:task-eo-design-verify-xsnx4h.plain_language_description: Before anything is specified, the verification custodian checks the layouts and envelopes against what specification requires - that every layout position has a purpose and the envelopes cover the equipment classes involved. processes:task-eo-design-verify-xsnx4h.business_purpose: It exists so equipment is never specified into layouts that were never fully designed.
processes:task-eo-design-verify-xsnx4h.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a layout position with no stated purpose and logs the defect before equipment is specified.

processes:task-eo-design-record-vvz5sp.plain_language_name: File the Logistics Design Audit Record
processes:task-eo-design-record-vvz5sp.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the commitment trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What the committed design contains, and from which pieces it was consolidated, stays on file for the life of the network.
processes:task-eo-design-record-vvz5sp.business_purpose: It exists so the logistics design's standing as committed authority can be evidenced whenever build leans on it.
processes:task-eo-design-record-vvz5sp.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the commitment trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a build review would draw on.

processes:task-eo-design-confirm-6c8xz9.plain_language_description: When the design stands committed, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-eo-design-confirm-6c8xz9.business_purpose: It exists so build starts only from a logistics design confirmed as committed.
processes:task-eo-design-confirm-6c8xz9.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the committed design awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-eo-design-intake-pgz4m8.plain_language_description: The commit opens when the transport modes, routing logic, and node positions are handed over together as the pieces the logistics design must be consolidated from. processes:task-eo-design-intake-pgz4m8.business_purpose: It exists so the design is committed from registered pieces rather than from a loose sheaf of drawings.
processes:task-eo-design-intake-pgz4m8.practical_context: It opens when the designed pieces are presented for the commitment, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the transport modes, routing logic, and node positions as the commitment baseline, with audit references, and opens the consolidation.

processes:task-eo-design-transform-q96ue.plain_language_name: Consolidate the Logistics Design for the Build
processes:task-eo-design-transform-q96ue.plain_language_description: With the pieces verified, the processing custodian does the consolidation itself: transport modes, routing logic, and node positions are brought together into the committed logistics and routing design, and the committed design is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-design-transform-q96ue.business_purpose: It exists because designs scattered across documents build nothing - the commit is where the logistics design becomes one authority ready for build.
processes:task-eo-design-transform-q96ue.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified pieces are ready to be consolidated, and it ends with the committed logistics design produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the operations function consolidates the pieces into the committed logistics and routing design, ready for build, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-design-verify-5kf4yu.plain_language_name: Check the Pieces Before Committing the Logistics Design
processes:task-eo-design-verify-5kf4yu.plain_language_description: Before the design is committed, the verification custodian checks the pieces against what commitment requires - that modes, routing, and positions are all settled and none arrived half-drawn. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the commitment is made.
processes:task-eo-design-verify-5kf4yu.business_purpose: It exists so the design is never committed from pieces that were only partly drawn.
processes:task-eo-design-verify-5kf4yu.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the pieces can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the node positions still carrying alternatives and logs the defect before the design is committed.

processes:task-eo-design-record-zn4ddp.plain_language_name: File the Routing Logic Audit Record
processes:task-eo-design-record-zn4ddp.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the design trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. processes:task-eo-design-record-zn4ddp.business_purpose: It exists so the routing logic behind the network's behaviour can be evidenced whenever a routing decision is questioned.
processes:task-eo-design-record-zn4ddp.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the routing trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a logistics review would consult.

processes:task-eo-design-confirm-tf4y8r.plain_language_description: When the logic stands designed, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-eo-design-confirm-tf4y8r.business_purpose: It exists so the design is committed only over logic confirmed as specified.
processes:task-eo-design-confirm-tf4y8r.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the routing specification awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-eo-design-intake-vf2j2z.practical_context: It opens when the mode selections and designs are presented for routing design, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps cleared to proceed.

processes:task-eo-design-transform-n5qx6.plain_language_description: With the requirements verified, the processing custodian does the design itself: the routing rules and algorithms governing how flows traverse the network are worked out and set down in the form the activity defines. processes:task-eo-design-transform-n5qx6.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified requirements are ready to be designed from, and it ends with the routing logic specification produced and the working papers kept.

processes:task-eo-design-verify-d2djdx.plain_language_name: Check the Requirements Before Designing the Routing
processes:task-eo-design-verify-d2djdx.plain_language_description: Before any routing is designed, the verification custodian checks the mode selections and designs against what routing design requires - that every designed mode carries its service level and none is left unstated. processes:task-eo-design-verify-d2djdx.business_purpose: It exists so routing is never designed against commitments that were only partly stated.
processes:task-eo-design-verify-d2djdx.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the requirements can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a mode with no service level behind it and logs the defect before routing is designed.
